content:
Earlier this year, Twelve South launched a new Valet accessory, which it described as a "wireless charging station and personal catchall."

Now Twelve South has expanded the Valet lineup with a smaller option, featuring MagSafe and Qi2.2 wireless charging at speeds up to 25W.

The first-generation Valet announced earlier this year measured 7.5 inches, with plenty of room to hold a phone, keys, wallet, glasses, and more. But the new version of Valet has been significantly scaled down to 4.25 inches.

Here's how Twelve South describes the ultra-premium design of Valet:

Valet is first a beautiful home accessory, then a precision wireless charger, combining warm materials with modern precision craftsmanship to create a calmer, more intentional form that fits anywhere in the home—from the entryway console to the kitchen to the nightstand. The soft, square charging pad echoes the architectural lines of the leather tray. Meanwhile, the weighted zinc alloy base keeps everything stable and tidy.

In terms of functionality, the smaller Valet has plenty of power to charge your iPhone. It also includes an additional USB-C port for conveniently charging other accessories:

  • Qi2.2 wireless charging up to 25W
  • Premium Nappa leather tray
  • Four configurable placement modes
  • Interchangeable, removable leather frame
  • Weighted zinc alloy base with hidden cable management
  • Additional USB-C port supporting up to 10W wired charging
  • Includes 45W power adapter and 1.5m USB-C cable

The 4.25-inch Twelve South Valet is now available for pre-order at $129.99, offered in three color combinations. It's not cheap, but it's a great-looking spot to set down your phone to charge while also holding your phone, wallet, or keys.
